value: A wind-swept mountain radio observatory platform at blue hour, one large parabolic dish, frost on metal grating and distant dark ridgelines, no other people

A loose slate-gray insulated field jumpsuit opened at the collar over a black thermal mock-neck, a compact crimson safety harness, gray work gloves and heavy black lace-up boots; practical contemporary technical wear
Full-body eye-level front three-quarter composition, entire kneeling figure and both boots visible beside the dish feed assembly, cool twilight with one warm task lamp

She kneels on one padded knee while tightening a fastener on the radio dish feed horn with one compact torque wrench in her right hand; her left hand steadies the bracket. Preserve the SAME clearly adult Slavic woman from the attached Virgo portrait: short wide oval face, pale skin, medium crimson eyes with downturned outer corners, prominent defined nose, thin lips, blunt short black bob with straight bangs, heavy-built body and broad shoulders. Exactly TWO normal human arms, TWO hands and TWO legs, anatomically correct. Render her completely as a contemporary human: no armor, giant shoulders, Planet Defensors, cannon, power cable, helmet, mechanical joints or sensors. She studies the fastener with a serious expression, not at the viewer. Fully opaque secure workwear, no readable text, logos or watermark.
